Hello Sarah, Professor Alvarez here. I'd like to set up our CSE455 staff meeting for next week. These are times I have free — do any of them work for you?

- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30

If none of those fits, tell me when you're free and I'll check my own calendar.

Hello Professor Alvarez — good to hear from you.

Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works for me: I'm free then, and it sits right before my CSE455 office hours, so that's convenient. I've put it on my calendar for next week (Tuesday 23 November, 15:00-15:30).

For the record, Monday 14:00-14:30 is taken (seminar) and Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is taken (quiz section), so Tuesday was the only one of the three that was free on my side.

Sarah

Perfect, thank you. Tuesday 23 November, 15:00-15:30 it is — it's on my calendar, and I've logged the booking. See you then, and thanks for confirming so quickly.

— Prof. Alvarez

Great — Tuesday 23 November, 15:00-15:30 is on both calendars. See you then, and I'll have the CSE455 grading status ready for the meeting.

Sarah
